concept.prompt: Edit this top-down game room into a REALIZABLE COMPOSITION CONCEPT for the SAME 2D game, not a cinematic illustration. Preserve EXACTLY the outer rectangle, all walls and the north/south/west openings, the straight vertical overhead orthographic camera and the two existing stone low-cover bases at their exact positions. Preserve the approved dark wall mass and pale raised edge. The idea is 'funerary order beginning to fail': an ossuary for storing exhumed remains, once carefully arranged, now locally deteriorating. REMOVE all four isolated thematic material islands, all water, campfire, pan, adventurer equipment, shovel and large forest roots. Use a continuous quiet worn grey-taupe flagstone floor throughout. Along the NORTH wall on both sides of its doorway and down the EAST wall, integrate a rhythm of low long narrow limestone ossuary recesses entirely INSIDE the thick blocked wall footprint. Several small ceramic ash urns sit properly INSIDE these stone recesses on dark inset shelves, in deliberate rows, not floating on edges or scattered in the walking area. The northwest end of this row has ONE damaged recess: chipped frame, a short connected spill of aged small bones and masonry chips immediately below it. Fine old roots enter at the same broken northwest masonry joints and follow the wall base, fading as delicate branches; no root tree, no isolated earth patch. Keep the architecture still solid, no new opening. A dust accumulation hugs the wall base and the damaged recess; no large brown ovals. The existing northeast low stone base becomes an open stone funerary receptacle with a few neatly collected old bones; the southwest base retains a closed weathered funerary container. No extra blocking furniture, no big objects in the central floor. A little sparse debris at the foot of the damaged recess connects it to the floor. Broad center and all three approach routes remain quiet, open and readable for combat. Soft even neutral game sprite lighting only; no candles, shafts of light, dramatic fog, extra architecture or tall perspective walls. Same modest painterly material fidelity as the supplied game's actual sprites. Finite sparse reusable objects, no impossibly intricate mural or density. Unify the entire room by repeated architectural rhythm, one local break in that rhythm, and wear following actual use. No labels or UI.

sprites.prompt: Create a FINAL REUSABLE TRANSPARENT GAME SPRITE SHEET for the supplied top-down ossuary concept, matching its modest hand-painted grey-beige limestone, aged ceramic, dusty ivory bone and dark brown thin roots. This is not another room scene. Landscape sheet in EXACTLY 3 columns x 2 rows of equal square cells, six separate objects each wholly inside its own cell with transparent gutters, no text, labels, grid lines or floor backdrop. Straight orthographic vertical overhead view, neutral diffuse lighting, no perspective front faces. TOP LEFT: a LONG NARROW horizontal limestone ossuary wall recess, body roughly 3.5 times wider than tall, complete thick chipped frame, dark inset shelf, THREE small ceramic ash urns neatly seated INSIDE the recess and attached by contact shadows, none floating outside the frame; the whole body must stay within a flat 3:1 footprint. TOP MIDDLE: damaged version of the same long narrow recess, one end of the frame chipped and partly collapsed, two urns and an old bundle of small bones exposed inside, a FEW fragments attached directly to the damaged end, compact, no large rubble island. TOP RIGHT: small low cluster of a few exhumed aged human bones, one small skull, ribs and long bones deliberately gathered, not a whole lying skeleton, no blood, sparse reusable floor vestige. BOTTOM LEFT: very sparse flat limestone chips and fine grey dust in an elongated irregular trail, dense at one end and thinning to individual specks at the other, no brown earth oval, no rectangular ground tile, transparent between specks. BOTTOM MIDDLE: THIN old branching tree roots as a delicate flat wall-base intrusion, long main horizontal root with three fine secondary branches mostly extending downward, subdued dark umber, NO trunk, NO tree, NO dirt or forest ground, alpha between branches, clear long narrow irregular silhouette. BOTTOM RIGHT: open low rectangular limestone funerary casket, horizontal, viewed from straight above, weathered rim and dark interior, a FEW old human bones collected respectfully inside, no corpse, no new loose lid beside it. Each object centered in its cell, full silhouette and at least 10 percent transparent margin, no overlap between cells. The niche modules must be NARROW so they fit the one-cell-thick wall; make the urns small enough to sit on the recessed inner shelf. Crisp readable material forms at game scale, no glossy highlights or supernatural glow, no pixel art, no cartoon outlines. TRUE transparent alpha background everywhere outside the six objects.
